name: Guidonia Montecelio (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and red, the yellow charged with the crowned municipal arms of Guidonia Montecelio (a figure on blue and S.P.Q.C. on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Guidonia Montecelio, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Guidonia Montecelio arms — figure on blue and S.P.Q.C. on red, crowned, within branches
